feeds.title: Sarasota Magazine » Health & Fitness
feeds.description: Read more on fitness and exercise, health news, healthy food, and wellness events in Sarasota, Florida. Sarasota Magazine is a hub for conversation about the best of Sarasota.

feeds.title: Florida Health and Wellness Magazine
feeds.description: Explore patients' health and treatment stories, tips and advice from experts, healthcare industry news, and more! The Central Florida Health and Wellness Magazine provides health and wellness tips from local healthcare providers like the Villages, Ocala, and Tampa.

feeds.title: Brevard Health Alliance Blog
feeds.description: Brevard Health Alliance blog features several pieces informing you on different ways of staying healthy and how our providers can help you. Brevard Health Alliance, Inc. is Brevard County's only Federally Qualified Health Center. BHA provides extensive primary health care services to Brevard County residents regardless of their ability to pay.

feeds.title: THOMAS HEALTH BLOG
feeds.description: Vital information from Dr. Daniel Thomas you need to know to live healthier and longer.

feeds.title: Florida Community Health Centers Blog
feeds.description: Community Health Center provides accessible, cost-effective, high-quality, comprehensive primary and speciality health care to all persons in our communities - through a network of Centers surrounding Lake Okeechobee and across Florida's Treasure Coast. Our blog features more advice for better health, news and more!

feeds.title: Virtual Psychiatric Care Blog
feeds.description: Virtual Psychiatric Blog includes resources for people who are interested in mental health. Featuring the latest research, stories of recovery, and ways to end stigma. Virtual Psychiatric Care is a national telehealth platform providing access to caring, affordable, and quality psychiatric services.

feeds.title: South Florida Health Care Institute Blog
feeds.description: South Florida Health Care Institute offers healthcare training classes for people who want to learn life-saving techniques. Learn more about the first-aid, the healthcare industry, our courses and more!

feeds.title: UF Health Jacksonville Blog
feeds.description: Health and wellness blog of UF Health Jacksonville and the University of Florida College of Medicine - Jacksonville features information and advice on various health problems, treatments, preventive measures and more! At UF Health Jacksonville, exemplary medical care is complemented by outstanding service. Our mission - to heal, to comfort and to educate - guides every interaction with patients, families and visitors.

feeds.title: Mount Sinai Medical Center Blog
feeds.description: Learn more about Mount Sinai Medical Center's ongoing commitments to the advancement of health care in our community. Founded in 1949, Mount Sinai Medical Center is the largest private, independent, not-for-profit teaching hospital in South Florida.

feeds.title: VIPcare Blog
feeds.description: The field of healthcare is always changing. Keep in touch with the latest in modern healthcare with posts from our medical professionals and authors. We are a group of passionate healthcare professionals who believe there's a better way to practice medicine. We see a future where preventative medicine is valued over the traditional approach, what we refer to as 'sick' care. We thrive on seeing our patients healthy, not sick.

feeds.title: North Florida Medical Center Blog
feeds.description: North Florida Medical Center is a unique, all-in-one facility, offering a full spectrum of COMPREHENSIVE family care medical services and chiropractic care for the entire family. Learn more about health, well-being, advice and tips, news and more!

feeds.title: Baptist Health
feeds.description: Baptist Health offers an extensive range of medical, surgical and technological services - including cancer, neuroscience, heart and vascular, sports medicine and orthopaedics. Learn more about your health, diseases, symptoms, treatments, the latest news in healthcare and more!

feeds.title: Halifax Health Blog
feeds.description: Stay up to date with the latest in medical news and information with our Halifax Health medical blog. For the past 80 years, Halifax Health has provided high-quality healthcare to East Central Florida.

feeds.title: USF Health News
feeds.description: We are an enterprise for change in the way we understand health and how it transforms our quality of life. USF Health's mission is to envision and implement the future of health. Our commitment is to improve the full spectrum of health, from the environment, to the community, to the individual. Together through talent and innovation, USF Health is integrating research, education and health care to reach our shared value - making life better.
